correctness.rationale: The source cardinality formula gives 2^(7-4) times 4^(4-2)=128 codewords for the displayed Example 1. Because the source Gray map is injective and binary linear, its image therefore has binary dimension seven, not five. The inspected verifier independently reconstructs the F4 module action and the five printed mixed-alphabet rows, obtains exactly 128 mixed codewords and 128 Gray images, rank seven of the resulting binary generator, minimum distance four and the complete weight distribution 1,12,30,63,18,4 at weights 0,4,6,8,10,12.

The exact 128-word weight enumerator is additional finite information and was not located in prior searches, but it does not make the package's principal 'dimension seven not five' claim original under the stated implication standard.
